parameters.content:
## automation-health-monitor — setup

Required environment variables (n8n: Settings > Variables, or instance env):

- `N8N_BASE_URL` — e.g. https://praecipio.app.n8n.cloud (no trailing slash)
- `N8N_API_KEY` — n8n API key (Settings > n8n API). Read-only use: GET executions only.
- `ATLASSIAN_SITE` — e.g. https://praecipio.atlassian.net (no trailing slash)
- `ATLASSIAN_AUTH_B64` — base64("email:api_token") from https://id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens
- `ATLASSIAN_PROJECT_KEY` — Jira project key, default GTM

What it does: every 6h it pulls errored executions, clusters them by workflow + node + error signature, drafts a suggested fix per cluster, and opens one Jira issue per cluster labeled `automation-health`. The execution-analyst agent picks those issues up, verifies root cause, proposes the patch, transitions the issue, and emails Patrick.

No secrets are embedded in this workflow — credentials come from env only.
